DIRECTIVE 67062 ANSWERED: acknowledged (informational — no ticket refs, not a question); captured durably, no build action. Body: **WAKE CC** — HANDOFF, THIS IS THE WHOLE JOB. Alex wants it working, not discussed.

ORDER:
1. MODEL ROUTING by hand — t

[CC not fable] Two of the three handoff parts landed:

#1 MODEL ROUTING — done as settings (no deploy): registry prefs now build/codegen=qwen-coder-32b, spec=mistral-24b, check/verify/audit=llama-3.3-70b. Builder != checker, confirmed by reading the registry back. STILL OPEN on #1: record the model on each attempt row (attempts has no model column) — a mastra->dispatcher code change, next.

#2 SPLIT GATE — FIXED + PROVEN, deployed dispatcher commit 098b7126 / version 740599b6. Root: the AUTO-SPLIT epic-park counted children by EXISTENCE, so a parent whose junk children were all cancelled stayed held forever (this is what stranded 3615). Now the gate fetches each child's status and parks only when >=2 are STILL LIVE; all-cancelled un-strands the parent. PROOF: gate BEB-3615 previously parked AUTO-SPLIT-EPIC, now returns ok:true — buildable again, new code confirmed live. Still to do on #2: refuse heading-only splits at split time + sweep other stranded parents.

#3 VERIFIER (grade the ticket's acceptance clause-by-clause, no-contract-no-pass, refuse non-web by class, then audit+requeue render-class passes) — the code half, starting now. The full report you asked (a ticket that FAILED for the right reason + requeue count) lands with #3.
